mechanicalExtractionRule: All original file bytes must remain identical or reconstruct exactly from portable prefix plus Windows suffix. Whole-file renames remain byte-identical; Windows headers duplicate original import/helper prefix. No callback, assertion, registration options, names or loops may change. Every original body is therefore covered by full-file SHA256 plus exact reconstruction. New harness tests are separate files. Runtime identity keys use original file/full parent/name/occurrence, mapping destination file explicitly.
